notes: APPROVED at GATE 0 by Aaryan, Oct 16 (FSFW included as A2; Altria, Vectura, Swedish Match rejected; T10202 cap 20000). Scope caveat: FSFW was reportedly renamed and its PMI funding reported ended around 2023-24 (not verified here). Discovery run 2026-10-16 with discover.py (candidates_*.json in this folder). Family = PMI funder plus the PMI US ROR record and its two ROR children (Switzerland, Germany); the loader's lineage filter on I4210088192 already includes the children. Foundation for a Smoke-Free World is kept as a separate funder with kind foundation (Tier A2, like the Coca-Cola Foundation), never merged into the company. TieTrace does not label it: OpenAlex's funder description reads "front organization of tobacco corporation Philip Morris" (Wikidata-sourced, Q106505816), and the WHO statement is titled "WHO statement on Philip Morris-funded Foundation for a Smoke-Free World" (https://www.who.int/news/item/28-09-2017-who-statement-on-philip-morris-funded-foundation-for-a-smoke-free-world). Topic: the loader filters on primary_topic only, so the phrase 'lung cancer screening' (12,703 title/abstract works) cannot be used; T10202 is the only topic /topics?search returns for it and it is wider than screening (surgery, treatment). No public_ids: no public case. topic_cap 20,000 (not 30,000) because lung cancer papers are larger author lists than obesity papers and this machine has about 4 GB free.
